"I Hope" is a song recorded by American country music singer Gabby Barrett.
She released the single independently following her third-place finish on season 16 of American Idol.
It led to her signing a deal with Warner Music Nashville, and it was released on July 29, 2019, as her debut single and the first from her debut studio album Goldmine.
